title: Brazil Country Climate and Development Report: Executive Summary
temporal_coverage: Current climate-risk diagnostic, historical loss estimates and modeled poverty impacts through 2030.
methodology: Executive summary distills modeled national climate risks, poverty pathways and sector and institutional options.
limitations: Only the 14-page executive summary was used; projections do not establish local incidence.

title: Severe droughts reduce river navigability and isolate communities in the Brazilian Amazon
organization: Communications Earth & Environment; authors from Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais and partner research institutions
temporal_coverage: Settlement datasets dated 2020-2021; reported drought impacts from 2000-2020; hydrological series assessed through 2021.
methodology: Maps settlement proximity to rivers and roads, codes reported drought impacts and analyzes 90 river-gauge time series.
limitations: Media-reported impacts are incomplete; distance screening indicates isolation risk, not observed isolation for each settlement.

title: Climate-related Crisis in the Amazon Region: Flash Update No. 1, Reporting Period August-September 2024
organization: UNICEF Latin America and Caribbean Regional Office
temporal_coverage: Situation and response snapshot for August-September 2024, with near-term risks and planned UNICEF actions.
methodology: Flash update combines state, Indigenous-organization and humanitarian coordination data with UNICEF response monitoring.
limitations: Dated situation snapshot; some population and service figures are relayed from third parties, not a prevalence study.

title: Impact of drought in the Brazilian Amazon and 2025 outlook
temporal_coverage: Secondary review of the 2023-2024 drought and humanitarian access conditions, with outlook for 2025.
methodology: Seven-page thematic report based on review of public secondary sources.
limitations: Remote-area needs and access data are explicitly scarce; armed-group information is synthesized from cited sources.

title: Impacts of the Floods in Rio Grande do Sul: Observations and Recommendations for the Guarantee of Economic, Social, Cultural, and Environmental Rights
organization: Inter-American Commission on Human Rights, Special Rapporteurship on Economic, Social, Cultural and Environmental Rights (REDESCA)
temporal_coverage: Mission conducted December 2-6, 2024, documenting impacts and response to the April-May 2024 floods.
methodology: December 2024 mission, meetings with authorities, civil society, scientists and affected communities, plus document review.
limitations: State-specific mission; reported figures draw partly on administrative and secondary sources, not a representative survey.
